run_eval_model: run eval_model to evaluate a PyTorch model on semantic segmentation tasks using KNN or logistic regression classifiers
run_KNNClassifier: run KNNClassifier to fit a K-nearest-neighbors classifier on frozen features extracted from a segmentation model
run_LogregClassifier: run LogregClassifier to fit a cuML logistic regression classifier with L-BFGS solver on segmentation features
run_mIoU: run mIoU to compute the macro-averaged Jaccard index between ground truth and predicted segmentation labels
run_main: run main to load a model from config and evaluate it on ADE20K or custom segmentation datasets
